title: Write or improve a Learn tutorial
summary: Tutorials are the step-by-step guides in the Learn panel. Improve one for a template, or write one for a new template, so it explains how the game works and invites changes.
why: Tutorials turn a template from 'a game' into 'a lesson'.

steps.text: Pick a template to improve (or your own new template). Play it and follow its tutorial in the Learn panel, noting what was unclear.
Look at templates/platformer/tutorial.json to see the format: each step has a title and text, and can 'open' a script, 'select' an object or ask to 'play'.
Write 5 to 8 steps. Start by playing, then explain one idea per step, then give a challenge.
Check that every tutorial file is still valid JSON.
Make a game from the template and follow your tutorial in the Learn panel from start to finish.

submit: Open a pull request with the new tutorial.json. Put 'Quest: write-a-tutorial' in the description.
